segments.he:
תּוֹרָה צ
עַל־יְדֵי שֶׁמְּשַׂמֵּחַ עַצְמוֹ בַּה', נִשְׁלָמִים כָּל הַחֶסְרוֹנוֹת בְּהַשְּׁכִינָה:
segments.en: Through conducting commerce in faithfulness [masah u'matan be'emunah] — the Name of Heaven becomes beloved through him. And one fulfils the positive commandment of "and you shall love" — which is the root of all commandments — as written in the Tikkunim, Tikkun 20.
